description: an old man archdruid with a calm dignified face in clean profile, one eye, a straight nose and the mouth closed under the moustache, no grimace, a long white beard braided with green leaves, a grand crown of tall antlers entwined with ivy and glowing green leaves, robes of moss, bark and oak leaves, a mantle of oak leaves and ivy, a belt of roots, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, clothes and colours; the hands empty, without the staff

the same character's other gender, whose walk the author accepted: the same robes, mantle, belt and crown of antlers, and how the robe falls, the strict side view and the near arm hanging beside the body; only the face, hair and body are different
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
